tools.name: search-documents
tools.description: Search a document corpus with a keyword or semantic query and return ranked results.

tools.name: fetch-document
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a document by its ID.

tools.name: summarise-text
tools.description: Transform a long text into a concise summary using an extractive algorithm.

tools.name: extract-entities
tools.description: Parse and extract named entities (people, places, organisations) from text.

tools.name: store-result
tools.description: Save an analysis result object to the results store with a given key.

tools.name: run-classifier
tools.description: Execute a pre-trained classifier on input text and return predicted label and confidence.

tools.name: monitor-queue
tools.description: Subscribe to and stream events from a message queue topic.

tools.name: delete-document
tools.description: Permanently remove a document from the corpus by its ID.
